'''Maestro''' was a title within the performing arts. [[Trebian Shullos]], who produced ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'' [[Opera/Legends|opera]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], held the title of Maestro.<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
